reasons: Accessorial code LAD is not listed in the BOL's authorized_accessorials (authorized: RES,LGD,NOA).
Contract Schedule C requires authorization for LAD; no authorization noted on BOL.
All other charges (linehaul, fuel surcharge, RES, NOA) are consistent with contract terms.
decision.dispute_summary: LAD accessorial (Lift gate - delivery) is not authorized on the BOL; only LGD is permitted. The $96.00 charged for LAD is not payable.
